moral_decision.Description: A value from 1 to 4 that indicates how morally wrong the subject found the vignette to be, where 1 is “not at all wrong” and 4 is “extremely morally wrong.” If a subject didn’t make a buttonpress in time, the script will print “NaN” (not a number).  Note that only the first buttonpress is recorded; make sure to instruct the subjects to that effect. Note: in OA code the subject will also be aware of it from on screen feedback (i.e. the number s/he chose would change to red on the screen and choosing additional numbers would not change that).

RT.Description: The time in seconds it took for the subject to make the first buttonpress during the trial.

press_order.Description: The order in which the stimuli were presented (1-24).

vigtext.Description: The specfic text that was shown on the vignette.

cond_id.Description: The vignette number within its condition. This is useful for item-level analyses.

vig_id.Description: The unique identifier for each vignette item
